Audemars Piguet · ref. 77605OK

Royal Oak Offshore

Luxury sports chronograph · 37–44mm · 50–100m · automatic · 2014–2025

The Royal Oak Offshore is a bold and robust luxury sports watch, defined by its oversized case, octagonal bezel with exposed screws, and prominent chronograph function. It represents a more muscular and aggressive evolution of the original Royal Oak design.

The story

Launched in 1993 to celebrate the Royal Oak's 20th anniversary, the Offshore was designed by Emmanuel Gueit to appeal to a younger, sport-oriented audience. Its large 42mm case earned it the nickname "The Beast" and was initially met with some controversy, but it ultimately pioneered the trend of oversized watches. Over the years, the family has expanded to include various sizes, innovative materials like ceramic and carbon fiber, and more advanced in-house movements. A significant update in 2021 introduced a redesigned 43mm collection featuring the integrated Calibre 4401 flyback chronograph.
